notes.title: HWR: Reforged — Sins of the Floating City. New DLC announcement and release date.
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/fbf8267353a5507ad8ab002b19eec99774c9ea3f.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We are happy to finally make an official announcement of Heads Will Roll: Reforged's fourth D[b]LC — Sins of the Floating City[/b]. It is scheduled to be released on [b]September 4th 10am PDT[/b] and will continue to expand the world and story of HWR. This time with two new massive story branches that will be taking place in Italy during Venice-Genoa wars. As always, the DLC will be accompanied by a major patch containing new items, gameplay mechanics, updated balancing and lots of technical iprovements.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]What awaits you in the DLC:
[/h2][p][b]*No step too far, no measure too desperate
[/b]Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.[/p][p][b]*A descent into darkness
[/b]Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/badef4b721b81d14272c5722cff02a99c10b10c7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]*More than a dozen new characters
[/b]From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.[/p][p][b]*Europe-spanning adventure
[/b]Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.[/p][p][b]*2 new romantic interests
[/b]Each with their own unique story and character.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/de5a0f1403bd320b2b6a6b6698af6a006edf6ad3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/1243e4136a45c7845858c8fafd31d6732032bab6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As always together with the DLC we will be releasing a big gameplay update that will, among other things, include:[/p][p][b]• [/b]new mechanics, items, weapons and civic talents;[/p][p]• improved survival mode;[/p][p]• a lot of bugfixes and several performance improvements;[/p]

notes.title: Console Patch XBOX and PLAYSTATION
notes.notes:
Hello friends.

We are excited to announce that a new patch has been released for We. The Revolution on Xbox and PlayStation. 

We've addressed many issues, for a long time garnered thanks to the console players' feedback.

notes.title: THE AMAZING AMERICAN CIRCUS WITH A NEW RELEASE DATE, BETA TESTS AND TRAILER
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

We have already informed you about the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433860/The_Amazing_American_Circus/]The Amazing American Circus game[/url]. In Klabater we treat it as an unofficial last part of our history-inspired trilogy which includes We. The Revolution as well. We really hope you guys will find The Amazing American Circus interesting!!! 

We are pleased to announce that The Amazing American Circus will hit PC and consoles on[b] August 12[/b] this year but that we will also like to share the new trailer and to let you know about upcoming beta tests for this game. 

First of all, please check the new trailer introducing the story of the game:

[previewyoutube=Pr4orTHO_as;full][/previewyoutube]

The decision to postpone the premiere to August is due to the commitment to the final quality and enjoyment of the game, and the additional time needed to properly certify the game on all console platforms. But we also want to let you test the game (below!). We are pleased with the quality of the game as it stands and believe that the best we can do in the coming weeks is just to let the gamers who follow the production play it.

[b]BETA TESTS[/b]

Tomorrow ([b]May 7[/b]) Klabater will start the initial beta testing phase of the game. The players who supported the game during the successful Kickstarter campaign will get to play it first. 

Buuut… on [b]May 20[/b], the open beta tests will begin, which will be carried out with the help of the [b]Steam Playtest[/b] mechanics - details will be provided soon (it is worth following the information appearing on the official [url=https://discord.gg/zJxgnMguvY]The Amazing American Circus Discord channel[/url]). Players will be able to test fragments of the first of the four regions available in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31187053/79750b50d7f0fb28538c562ce8ba1fd4f4d84cb5.jpg[/img]

Below is a planned map of the development of Klabater's flagship title for 2021:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31187053/0cbd1131905fd50c83d51dc32c5f73aa5f9363de.jpg[/img] 

The Amazing American Circus is a blend of a Slay the Spire-style card game with Tycoon and simulation mechanics, as well as thoughtful resource management. Manage not only your artists but the entire circus camp. How you expand your circus depends only on you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31187053/26746fa376c648717a2e9a9afb8dba8a7d129e05.png[/img]

What The Amazing American Circus has to offer?:

🎪 Become a legend! Save a run-down circus, gather a troupe of performers, and dare to defy the greatest showman on earth - P.T Barnum himself.
🎪 Recruit and train over 15 different types of circus artists
🎪 Take part in exciting battles on the circus arena using the beautifully illustrated collectible cards
🎪 Upgrade your circus caravan thanks to different types of wagons offering over 100 possible modifications
🎪 Meet both historical and fictional characters deeply embedded in American folklore, such as John D. Rockefeller, Susan B. Anthony, or Nikola Tesla
🎪 Immerse yourself in a story taking place during the turbulent era of the fading Wild West and enter the beautiful and dark world of Native American folklore and the immigrant populace
🎪 Listen to a unique soundtrack inspired by classic circus music and American country & folk

[b]The Amazing American Circus will be released on August 12, 2021[/b]!

[/list]

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31187053/d2e5182aa2cbf41f2fb4508e923c1053e2c096ff.jpg[/img]

We get a lot of feedback that you guys are constantly interested in new additions to the game. And as always, we're on duty! And this time we have something special for you:) Not just your usual patch, but really cool addition to the game.

We have worked on special [b]"Arena mode"[/b] for [i]We. The Revolution[/i] for some time. Thanks to this mode you will be able to delve into the times of the French Revolution again. We know that many of you enjoy the court cases the most! So, Arena mode will let you play just court cases without involving into family issues and strategical clashes on map of Paris.

You may try to resolve each case in a different way each time - of course you still need to worry about not being lynched or called a traitor. There are 44 cases overall solving which will let you earn points in the world ranking! So, you may compete not only with the game itself but also with other gamers!

Another huge addition is support for the[b] Russian language[/b]! Comrades, your revolution begins today! We heard many of you asked for it and here it is, enjoy!

notes.title: French Revolution courtroom drama We. The Revolution gets a release date
notes.notes:
We. The Revolution, an intriguing and attractive game about playing judge during the French Revolution, comes out 21st March 2019.

That's a PC release date but a Switch version is apparently due "shortly after". The press release doesn't mention a PlayStation 4 or Xbox One release.

Johnny played and wrote about We. The Revolution a couple of months ago, calling it "a horribly queasy game about life and death" which, to me, sounds irresistible.

Read more…
